quote: Reform of benefits and burdens will be continued, taking into account total benefit expenditures, public and insurance contributions, and the disposable income of working-age generations.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Strong and Prosperous Japan Investment Framework
quantified_targets: ["The framework will be established separately from ordinary expenditures.", "Regardless of the amount provided in the previous year's budget, genuinely effective investment support measures can be included.", "No request ceiling will be established, allowing the necessary amounts to be requested, including itemized requests."]
quote: A “Strong and Prosperous Japan” investment framework will be established separately from ordinary expenditures, including crisis-management and growth investments, so that measures contributing to raising potential growth through domestic investment can be implemented predictably.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Effective Investment Budget Formulation Mechanism
quantified_targets: ["Effective policy ideas that contribute to strengthening growth capacity and the necessary budgets will be included in initial budget requests without being bound by precedent.", "The requests will take into account competing successfully in international competition alongside foreign countries."]
quote: A mechanism will be developed to connect these requests to effective budgetary measures during the budget formulation process.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Supplementary Budget Dependence Reduction Reform
quantified_targets: ["This principle will be thoroughly implemented in the budget formulation process, including the stage of preliminary budget requests.", "Further concrete measures will be developed."]
quote: Supplementary budgets will be limited to measures of genuinely high urgency, while permanent measures will be provided for in the initial budget.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Local Government Fiscal Support Measures
quote: Necessary and sufficient local fiscal measures will be taken so that local fiscal management and smooth project implementation are not impeded.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: FY2027 Ministry Budget Request Process
quantified_targets: ["FY2027 budget formulation"]
quote: In the FY2027 budget formulation, each ministry and agency shall submit appropriate budget requests based on the above.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Comprehensive Public Fund Rules Review
quantified_targets: ["The review will consider the nature of each investment and the need for predictability for long-term investment, as well as flexible and efficient fund management.", "Current rule: budgetary measures are in principle limited to three years."]
quote: A fundamental review of the fund rules will be undertaken, including the non-application of the current rule that budgetary measures should in principle be limited to three years.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Strong and Prosperous Japan Investment Framework
quantified_targets: ["The framework will be developed based on the Growth Strategy and the Regional Future Strategy.", "It will address public-private investment roadmaps and cross-sectoral issues.", "The necessary and sufficient scale will be secured while achieving fiscal sustainability."]
quote: The Strong and Prosperous Japan Investment Framework, including crisis-management investment and growth investment, will target measures with a strong effect on substantially increasing domestic private capital investment and potential growth.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Supplementary and Initial Budget Classification Framework
quote: The budget formulation process will clarify the principles for distinguishing supplementary budgets from initial budgets.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Budget Policy Implementation Monitoring and Evaluation
quantified_targets: ["Verification and evaluation will be conducted at the Council on Economic and Fiscal Policy based on the basic policy for budget formulation."]
quote: At the Council on Economic and Fiscal Policy, the efforts undertaken based on this section will be verified and evaluated.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
name: Basic Budget Formulation Policy Revision
quantified_targets: ["Revision is to take place in the latter half of the year.", "The revision will consider the status of reflection in the FY2027 budget and changes in socioeconomic conditions, including the economic outlook."]
quote: In the latter half of the year, the basic policy for budget formulation will be revised as necessary, taking into account the status of its reflection in the FY2027 budget and changes in socioeconomic conditions, including the economic outlook.

plan_title: Basic Policy on Economic and Fiscal Management and Reform 2026 (Honebuto 2026)
